name: PER_ABSENCE_ATTENDANCES
description: This table holds details of employee absences from work. Records can be entered with PROJECTED dates and later confirmed as actual. Projected absences have no impact on absence balances.

columns.name: ABSENCE_ATTENDANCE_ID
columns.description: System generated primary key column.

columns.name: PERIOD_OF_SERVICE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to PER_PERIODS_OF_SERVICE table.

columns.name: LINKED_ABSENCE_ID
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: MATERNITY_ID
columns.description: ID of the maternity absence type that this absence is associated with.

columns.name: SSP1_ISSUED
columns.description: Indicates whether statutory sick pay was paid.

columns.name: PREGNANCY_RELATED_ILLNESS
columns.description: Indicates if this sickness absence is associated with maternity.

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: ABSENCE_ATTENDANCE_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to PER_ABSENCE_ATTENDANCE_TYPES_B table.

columns.name: ABS_ATTENDANCE_REASON_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to PER_ABS_ATTENDANCE_REASONS table.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to PER_PERSONS table. Identifies the person.

columns.name: PERIOD_OF_INCAPACITY_ID
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: DATE_END
columns.description: End date of the absence.

columns.name: DATE_NOTIFICATION
columns.description: Date when the worker notified employer about the absence.

columns.name: DATE_PROJECTED_END
columns.description: Projected end date of the absence.

columns.name: DATE_PROJECTED_START
columns.description: Projected start date of the absence.

columns.name: DATE_START
columns.description: Start date of the absence.

columns.name: TIME_END
columns.description: End time of the absence.

columns.name: TIME_PROJECTED_END
columns.description: Projected end time of the absence.

columns.name: TIME_PROJECTED_START
columns.description: Projected start time of the absence .

columns.name: TIME_START
columns.description: Start time of the absence.
